rules.label: Rent up to €800
rules.description: Retain the original named €850 exception. Mandatory parking and utilities are shown separately.

rules.label: At least 45 m²
rules.description: Use stated apartment area, excluding separately stated parking. Flag conflicting size figures.

rules.label: Existing search areas
rules.description: Keep the original Zagreb neighbourhood scope; no requirement to be immediately near KB Dubrava.

rules.label: Newer / refurbished
rules.description: Newer furnishing, new build, renovation from 2019 onward, or an explicit refurbished / first-rental claim.

rules.label: Drive to KB Dubrava ≤45 min
rules.description: Prefer ≤30 minutes. Typical driving time, not straight-line distance; parking and walking are separate. Unmeasured journeys need checking.

rules.label: Move in by 8 Nov 2026
rules.description: Exclude explicit availability dates after 8 November. Unknown availability needs checking.

rules.label: Long-term rental only
rules.description: No seasonal rentals or required summer move-outs. Unknown lease terms need checking.

rules.label: No basement / semi-basement
rules.description: Unknown floor levels need checking, rather than being assumed above ground.

rules.label: Lift on 3rd floor and above
rules.description: A lift is optional below the 3rd floor. Unknown floor or required lift access needs checking.

rules.label: Building from 1985 onward
rules.description: Construction year, not renovation year. Unknown years need checking; renovation does not exempt an older building.

rules.label: At least two rooms
rules.description: Original requirement, now switched off at your request.

rules.label: Separate bedroom
rules.description: Original requirement, now switched off at your request.
